data.summary: Beispiel Logistik GmbH sent an addendum to your employment contract on mobile working (up to two days per week) from 1 June 2026. You are asked to return it signed within 10 working days of the letter date (28 April 2026).
data.explanation: Your employer sent an addendum (Zusatzvereinbarung) allowing mobile working up to two days a week from 1 June 2026. If you agree, sign it and send it back to the HR department (Personalabteilung) by the deadline shown, which counts 10 working days (Monday to Saturday, excluding public holidays) from the letter date. Read the terms before signing. If anything is unclear, ask HR or seek advice.
